name: Master of Dark Rites
oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Add {B}{B}{B}. Spend this mana only to cast Vampire, Cleric, and/or Demon spells.
blocked_sentences: {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Add {B}{B}{B}. Spend this mana only to cast Vampire, Cleric, and/or Demon spells.

needs.what: a mana ability whose 'spend this mana only to...' clause names one or more creature subtypes (Vampire, Cleric, Demon) rather than a card type -- i.e. the ability's mana restriction must be able to hold a list of subtypes, and the purpose computed for the spell being paid for must include that spell's subtypes so a restricted source is offered when any one of them matches
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The existing mana restriction is a single lowercased card type: the loader rejects anything whose title-case form is not in the eight known card types, and the purpose a spell presents is built from that card's types alone, so subtypes are never consulted and 'Vampire, Cleric, and/or Demon' has no representation. Leaving the clause off would produce unrestricted {B}{B}{B}, which is strictly more permissive than the printed card.
